about: Opens a dialog from code and returns a promise of the value it closes with. An application creates an overlay once per component, renders its viewport once, and awaits `open` in a handler.

answer.about: A confirmation before a destructive action. The handler awaits `open`, which resolves with `true` when Delete closes the dialog and with `undefined` when Cancel or Escape dismisses it. Focus returns to the button that opened it.
answer.title: Await an answer

confirm.description: Everyone with the link loses access to it. You cannot undo this.
confirm.title: Delete the Q3 report?

title: Overlay

update.about: A dialog that code updates and closes. A timer passes the upload's progress to `update` every 400ms and closes the overlay with `done` at 100%. Cancel or Escape resolves `open` with `undefined`, and the handler stops the timer.
update.title: Update from code

value.about: A form whose value the handler needs. Save submits the form, the component closes the overlay with the trimmed name, and `open` resolves with it. Cancel resolves `open` with `undefined` and keeps the name.
value.title: Return a value
